Wear Time Multiday

Last updated: 2026-11-13 01:01:01

These timelines are used to explore and make potential corrections to parent-logged wear time based on automatically-detected wear time based on sensor movement. Use the drop-down menu to select a session and a day. The bottom timeline allows the user to select a range to zoom in. Each timeline can be dynamically panned, and hovering over the timeline indicates the data value. Values are smoothed over a 30-s window; each point represents the proportion of samples in the 30-s window labelled as “worn”.
